uzo.purpose: Moves to another view or place: it opens an overview, a detail, a document or an outside site; an icon may stand before the words (slot icon-start); with download it hands over a file instead, marked, the label names its type and size.

instead.kialo: A link moves to another view or place and a button starts an action here, because screen readers announce them differently, the keyboard operates them differently and the way back is different; an action on a link promises a move that does not happen.

boundary.kialo: A link that looks like a button is read as an action, because the shape promises one; whether a brand wants that is a decision of a person, not of the Ero.
A link one cannot follow is text, because a grey link promises a destination that is not there; show the text, or leave the link out.
A standalone link that breaks into lines no longer reads as one destination, because its neighbours stand in one line; in running text the label breaks with the text.
A link without a name cannot be followed, because assistive technology and voice control know only names and sighted people see only its text; the label prop alone shows nothing.

containers.name: text
containers.kialo: A reference stands where the thought needs it, because a reader follows it from the sentence, not from a list.

containers.name: navigation
containers.kialo: A navigation is a list of places, because each entry moves somewhere and none acts here.

containers.name: footer
containers.kialo: A footer holds the places a person looks for last (imprint, help), because they belong to every view and to none.

containers.name: card
containers.kialo: A card ends with the way to its detail, because the card is a summary and the detail its destination.

with.kialo: Links of one list stand together, because a list of places is read as one choice.
The items of a breadcrumb are links up the hierarchy, because each one moves to a level above; the last is text.
The mark of an external destination at the end of the link is an ikono external, because the sign that a place lies outside is vocabulary of the Ikonaro, drawn by the Aspekto in the size of the link.

never.kialo: A link stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name; and not in an action-bar, because a bar of actions reads a link as an action.

case.de: Etwas soll hier in der Ansicht geschehen, statt woanders hinzuführen.
case.en: Something is to happen here in the view, instead of leading elsewhere.

case.de: Mehrere Hauptseiten der Anwendung stehen als Liste, eine davon ist die aktuelle.
case.en: Several main pages of the application stand as a list, one of them the current one.

case.de: Gezeigt wird der Weg von oben bis zur aktuellen Seite.
case.en: The path from the top down to the current page is shown.

do.de: Lass die Wörter das Ziel nennen, nicht die Adresse.
do.en: Let the words name the destination, not the address.

do.de: Setze external für ein Ziel außerhalb der Anwendung; es wird sichtbar und hörbar markiert.
do.en: Set external for a destination outside the application; it is marked visibly and audibly.

do.de: Nenne bei download in den Wörtern die Datei, ihre Art und ihre Größe.
do.en: With download, name the file, its kind and its size in the words.

dont.de: Einen Verweis grau und unbenutzbar zeigen; ohne Ziel ist er Text.
dont.en: Show a link greyed out and unusable; without a destination it is text.

dont.de: Einen Download zugleich als external markieren, denn ein Download bleibt in der Ansicht.
dont.en: Mark a download as external at the same time, because a download stays in the view.

dont.de: Einen eigenständigen Verweis über mehrere Zeilen laufen lassen.
dont.en: Let a standalone link run over several lines.

action.de: Folgt dem Verweis; mit download übergibt er die Datei, und die Person bleibt in der Ansicht.
action.en: Follows the link; with download it hands over the file and the person stays in the view.
